chapters.content:
Better Than the Movies is a contemporary work by Lynn Painter (2021).

Rom-com obsessed high-school senior Liz Buxbaum enlists her annoying next-door neighbor Wes to help her land her lifelong crush.

Categorized under: Romance, YA, Coming-of-age.
